svg.aria-label: GLATRIX spelled out in a hex dump. Need at least 8 hours of research to function | A rotating 3D knowledge graph of technologies branching from GLATRIX: Agents + tooling, Local AI, Machine learning, Language tooling, Web, Services, .NET, Graphics + engines, Infra, Runtime internals, Process + IPC, Native + hooks, Bare metal | A neural network training in forward and backward passes, a falling loss curve, and top-k token sampling | A convolution kernel sliding over an 8 by 8 image of a seven, building a feature map, max pooling it, and classifying it as 7 with 94 percent confidence | Market forecasting on synthetic data: candlesticks and an EMA build up bar by bar, a forecast line with confidence bands extends from the last close, and the actual bars land inside it | An x64 trampoline hook: the first five bytes of a target function are copied to a trampoline, replaced with a jmp to the hook, and execution then flows target, hook, trampoline, and back | A terminal running help and donut. Click to open the interactive terminal.
